mapper.select: SELECT stop_id, stop_name, longitude, latitude FROM public.stops ORDER BY stop_id

WITH query_point AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint( CAST(#{longitude} AS double precision), CAST(#{latitude} AS double precision) ), 4326 )::geography AS point_geog ),
candidate_stops AS ( SELECT s.stop_id, s.stop_name, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.geom,
ST_Distance( s.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog ) AS distance_meters
FROM public.stops s CROSS JOIN query_point
WHERE ST_DWithin( s.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog, CAST(#{radiusMeters} AS double precision) ) ),
clustered_stops AS ( SELECT candidate_stops.*,
ST_ClusterDBSCAN( ST_Transform(geom, 3857), 10, 1 ) OVER ( PARTITION BY stop_name ORDER BY stop_id ) AS cluster_id
FROM candidate_stops ),
ranked_stops AS ( SELECT clustered_stops.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY stop_name, cluster_id ORDER BY distance_meters, stop_id ) AS row_number
FROM clustered_stops )
SELECT stop_id, stop_name, longitude, latitude, distance_meters FROM ranked_stops WHERE row_number = 1 ORDER BY distance_meters, stop_id
